status: bounded investigator probe; not autonomous-search qualification

mtp1a.hypothesis: accepted draft progress reduces TPOT enough to offset MTP overhead without increasing TTFT or reducing completed throughput
mtp1a.mechanism_evidence: server aggregate draft/accepted token counters, plus batch and queue metrics
mtp1a.falsification: low acceptance, slower TPOT, queue growth, or throughput loss at matched load

cap128a.hypothesis: cap 128 stays above observed peak concurrent work (53), avoiding the known cap-32 queue; smaller capture/scheduler envelope might alter cost
cap128a.mechanism_evidence: server running/waiting request gauges, graph capture logs, latency and throughput
cap128a.falsification: capacity waiting or material latency/throughput regression

mtp3a_if_mtp1_promising.hypothesis: higher acceptance length may improve decode more than depth 1, at the cost of extra draft work
mtp3a_if_mtp1_promising.mechanism_evidence: aggregate acceptance length, TTFT, TPOT, throughput, queue
mtp3a_if_mtp1_promising.falsification: draft overhead or falling acceptance erases depth-1 benefit

comparison_rules.interpretation: short screens show direction/mechanism only; p99 and production value remain provisional
